name: Full House ~Joyuu Monogatari~
source:
You are stage director hired to rebuild a troupe. Raise actresses, set up repetitions and performances to make theater popular again.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-august-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
你受聘成为舞台导演，负责重建一个剧团。培养女演员，安排排练与演出，让剧院重新流行起来。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-august-1998.html]vndreview[/url]]
